d:
Spiky, electric yellow short hair with a messy texture. Sharp, golden-yellow eyes with a confident expression. Appears to be in the late teens with a youthful, lean face. Slender and athletic build. Wearing a dusty brown cowboy vest over a cream-colored shirt, dark brown trousers, and a wide-brimmed tan stetson hat. Carrying two silver revolvers in leather holsters on the hips.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
